Summa vikter i ett lager: {{total}} para: Total weights in one layer: {{total}} parameters. Times 32 layers that is about 6.98 billion; the rest of the 8.03 billion is the embedding and the LM head.
No weight, nothing is stored in the model file.
Normaliserar en kopia av strömmen så att: Normalizes a copy of the stream so that the RMS becomes 1, then scales each dimension with a learned weight. The stream itself does not change.
Gör en key per token: vad positionen erb: Builds one key per token: what the position offers. 8 KV heads × 128. Written to the KV cache.
Gör en value per token: det som skickas: Builds one value per token: what gets passed on if the position is selected. Written to the KV cache.
Ingen vikt. En fast formel som vrider Q: No weight. A fixed formula that rotates Q and K depending on position, so that attention can sense distance.
Ingen vikt. Jämför varje query med alla: No weight. Compares every query with all earlier keys and turns the scores into weights that sum to 1.
Ingen vikt. Här, och bara här, flyttas i: No weight. Here, and only here, information moves between tokens.
Blandar ihop de 32 headsens resultat til: Mixes the results of the 32 heads into one contribution with the width of the stream, 4096.
Ingen vikt. Attention-bidraget adderas t: No weight. The attention contribution is added to the stream. Nothing is overwritten.
Samma sak som g₁, men före MLP:n och med: The same thing as g₁, but before the MLP and with its own weights.
14 336 detektorer. Varje kolumn är ett m: 14,336 detectors. Each column is a pattern compared with the token vector.
Ett värde per detektor, som skalas av ga: One value per detector, scaled by the gate.
Ingen vikt. Gaten släpper fram de detekt: No weight. The gate lets through the detectors that fired and is multiplied element-wise with up.
Komprimerar tillbaka till 4096 och skriv: Compresses back to 4096 and writes the MLP contribution. Each row is what one detector writes to the stream.
Ingen vikt. MLP-bidraget adderas. Strömm: No weight. The MLP contribution is added. The stream moves on to the next layer.
Ny kopia, nu av uppdaterade x: New copy, now of the updated x
RMSNorm delar varje tal med vektorns RMS: RMSNorm divides every number by the RMS of the vector, so the copy gets RMS 1 but keeps the same direction. The stream x itself is untouched. (The learned weight g₁ is set to 1 here.)
Attention läser kopian för den här posit: Attention reads the copy for this position and for all earlier positions, and fetches what is relevant. Out comes a contribution with the same shape as x. It is small compared with x.
Bidraget läggs ovanpå. Inget raderas: va: The contribution is laid on top. Nothing is deleted: each dimension has only been adjusted a little. The first row is done.
Andra raden börjar likadant, men x inneh: The second row starts the same way, but x now contains what attention just fetched. The copy is normalized with its own weight, g₂.
MLP:n ser bara den här positionens kopia: The MLP sees only the copy for this position, no other tokens. It reshuffles the dimensions and returns a contribution with the same shape.
Bidraget adderas och x går vidare till n: The contribution is added and x moves on to the next layer, where the same two rows run again with new weights. After 32 layers, x is the sum of the embedding and 64 such contributions.
<b>Attention</b> för ”{{token}}”: hämtar: Attention for “{{token}}”: fetches a weighted mixture of the rows above and its own (the percentages). Rows below are masked. Information moves between tokens, along T.
<b>MLP</b> för ”{{token}}”: bara den egn: MLP for “{{token}}”: only its own row is read. The dimensions are reshuffled within the row, along d. Every row goes through the same MLP weights, independent of the others.
Neuroner som slår till skriver sin riktn: Neurons that fire write their direction into the stream, which makes some continuations more likely: {{list}}.
Ingen neuron slår till tydligt. MLP-bidr: No neuron fires clearly. The MLP contribution is almost zero, and the stream passes through more or less unchanged.
Grammatiken har tagit form: efter ”den v: The grammar has taken shape: after “den var” an intensifier or an adjective usually comes.
Attention har hämtat ”Katten” och ”matta: Attention has fetched “Katten” and “mattan”. States that suit a cat are starting to show up.
Senare lager har dragit slutsatser av sa: Later layers have drawn conclusions from the context. “trött” leads clearly.
Efter sista lagret: den fördelning som s: After the last layer: the distribution that sampling actually draws from.
